notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
